castle.title: Castle dining room
castle.copy: A warm princess-style setup with a backdrop, dessert table, soft balloons, and photo moments for younger children.

space.title: Space mission room
space.copy: A blue and silver explorer setup with rocket details, task badges, and a clear party flow for active children.

forest.title: Forest adventure corner

home.localizedPackagesSubtitle: Choose the level that matches your budget, visual expectations, and party scale.

basic.title: Basic essentials
basic.copy: A controlled-budget setup with table styling, light theme decor, and a simple photo corner.

standard.title: Standard party experience
standard.copy: A complete party look with stronger theme decoration, backdrop, dessert-table styling, and supplier guidance.

premium.title: Premium immersive setup
premium.copy: A fuller visual experience with lighting layers, custom boards, stronger photo zones, and on-site coordination.
